axis_label.fate: same molecular consequence for the protein
axis_label.drugs: same compounds act on both proteins

fate_labels.absent: no protein made (predicted null: truncating, canonical splice, start loss, whole-gene loss)
fate_labels.inactive: protein present but inactive (loss of function)
fate_labels.dominant_negative: protein present and poisons its partners (dominant negative)
fate_labels.hyperactive: protein present and overactive (gain of function)
fate_labels.accumulates: protein accumulates / is not degraded (increased level)
